# 2 Chronicles Chapter 23 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-in-the-year the-seventh he-strengthened-himself Jehoiada and-he-took the-commanders-of the-hundreds Azariah son-of Jeroham and-Ishmael son-of Jehohanan and-Azariah son-of Obed and-Maaseiah son-of Adaiah and-Elishaphat son-of Zichri with-him in-the-covenant.

**2** And-they-went-about in-Judah and-they-gathered the-Levites from-all cities-of Judah and-heads-of the-fathers of-Israel and-they-came to-Jerusalem.

**3** And-he-made all the-assembly a-covenant in-house-of God with the-king and-he-said to-them behold son-of the-king shall-reign as-that spoke YHWH concerning sons-of David.

**4** This is the-thing that you-shall-do the-third from-you the-entering on-the-Sabbath of-the-priests and-of-the-Levites for-gatekeepers-of the-thresholds

**5** and-the-third in-house-of the-king and-the-third in-gate-of the-foundation and-all the-people in-courts-of house-of YHWH.

**6** And-let-none enter house-of YHWH except the-priests and-the-ministering of-the-Levites they shall-enter for holy they are and-all the-people shall-keep guard-of YHWH.

**7** And-they-shall-surround the-Levites the-king all-around each and-his-weapons in-his-hand and-the-coming to the-house shall-be-put-to-death and-be with the-king in-his-coming-in and-in-his-going-out.

**8** And-they-did the-Levites and-all Judah according-to-all that commanded Jehoiada the-priest and-they-took each his-men the-entering on-the-Sabbath with the-going-out on-the-Sabbath for not dismissed Jehoiada the-priest the-divisions.

**9** And-he-gave Jehoiada the-priest to-commanders-of the-hundreds the-spears and-the-shields and-the-quivers that were-for-the-king David that were-in house-of God.

**10** And-he-stationed all the-people and-each his-weapon in-his-hand from-side-of the-house the-right to side-of the-house the-left to-the-altar and-to-the-house upon the-king all-around.

**11** And-they-brought-out son-of the-king and-they-put upon-him the-crown and-the-testimony and-they-made-him-king and-they-anointed-him Jehoiada and-his-sons and-they-said let-live the-king.

**12** And-she-heard Athaliah the-sound-of the-people the-running and-the-praising the-king and-she-came to the-people to-house-of YHWH.

**13** And-she-looked and-behold the-king standing on his-pillar at-the-entrance and-the-commanders and-the-trumpets by the-king and-all people-of the-land rejoicing and-blowing the-trumpets and-the-singers with-instruments-of the-song and-announcing to-praise and-she-tore Athaliah her-garments and-she-said conspiracy conspiracy.

**14** And-he-brought-out Jehoiada the-priest the-commanders-of the-hundreds the-appointed-of the-army and-he-said to-them bring-her-out from-between the-ranks and-the-coming after-her shall-be-killed with-the-sword for said the-priest not you-shall-kill-her in-house-of YHWH.

**15** And-they-made for-her a-passage and-she-came to entrance-of gate-of the-horses house-of the-king and-they-killed-her there.

**16** And-he-cut Jehoiada a-covenant between-him and-between all the-people and-between the-king to-be a-people for-YHWH.

**17** And-they-came all the-people to-house-of the-Baal and-they-tore-it-down and-his-altars and-his-images they-broke and-Mattan priest-of the-Baal they-killed before the-altars.

**18** And-he-placed Jehoiada the-duties-of house-of YHWH in-hand-of the-priests the-Levites whom assigned David over house-of YHWH to-offer burnt-offerings-of YHWH as-written in-law-of Moses with-joy and-with-song by-hands-of David.

**19** And-he-stationed the-gatekeepers at gates-of house-of YHWH and-not shall-enter the-unclean for-any matter.

**20** And-he-took the-commanders-of the-hundreds and-the-nobles and-the-rulers over-the-people and-all people-of the-land and-he-brought-down the-king from-house-of YHWH and-they-came through the-gate the-upper to-house-of the-king and-they-seated the-king on throne-of the-kingdom.

**21** And-they-rejoiced all people-of the-land and-the-city was-quiet and-Athaliah they-killed with-the-sword.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **23:3**: son-of the-king shall-reign — The revelation of the surviving heir after six years of hiding. The covenant phrase 'as YHWH spoke concerning the sons of David' ties this restoration to the eternal promise.

- **23:11**: the-crown and-the-testimony — Hebrew ha-nezer ve-ha-'edut. The testimony (covenant document) given with the crown establishes that kingship is bound to Torah obedience.

- **23:16**: to-be a-people for-YHWH — The covenant renewal under Jehoiada restores the fundamental relationship: Israel belongs to YHWH. This is covenant theology in its simplest form.


— EMET
